in_marathi.name: Krithi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Creativity, Artistic, Divine work
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krithi refers to the creative act, the artistic expression, or the divine work. In Hindu mythology, Krithi is the goddess of art, music, and dance. She is also known as the embodiment of the creative power of the universe.
